description: Act 4 (SOCSO) Third Schedule as replaced by Act A1788 (Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act 2026), in force from contribution month June 2026. Adds the employee-only Non-Employment Injury (NEI / SKBBK / LINDUNG 24 Jam) share in three phases. Employer shares (employment injury 1.25%, invalidity 0.5%) and employee invalidity share (0.5%) are unchanged from the 2024 table.
lookup: Band i applies when wageAbove < monthlyWage <= wageUpTo (wageUpTo null = open-ended top band). Band 1 is 'wages up to RM30'. All amounts in RM. Wage ceiling RM6,000: bands 64 and 65 carry identical amounts.
nonEmploymentInjuryParticipation: Mandatory for everyone for contribution month June 2026. From 8 July 2026 (Cabinet decision, no gazetted instrument found as of 2026-11-05, partly on saved AGC portal listings, use pending owner decision) voluntary for LOCAL employees via opt-out (window 13 Jul - 31 Aug 2026; default = participating; opted-out employees may opt back in at any time, 'once in, always in'). Always mandatory for foreign workers. So NEI columns apply to participating employees only. Note the top amount starts ABOVE RM5,900: exactly RM5,900.00 is band 63. See docs/research/socso.md.

provenance: Parsed from the text layer of Act A1788 (all 6 parts, 65 rows each, row sums verified).

Phase 1 (Parts I and IV) verified cell-by-cell against PERKESO 'New Contribution Rate Including SKBBK' PDF (English) and 'Jadual Caruman Baharu Termasuk SKBBK' (Malay): 0 mismatches; also visually checked against Pekeliling Majikan Bil. 2/2026 Lampiran 1 & 2 (scanned).
Deep pass 2026-11-05: independent re-parses of Act A1788 Parts I-VI gave 0 mismatches across 3 phases x 2 categories x 65 bands; PERKESO EN and BM PDFs again 0/455 mismatches each.

Limit: P.U.(B) 195/2026 makes the ENGLISH text of Act A1788 authoritative, but the Act parsed here is the Malay text. The English statutory text was not retrieved. PERKESO's English PDF matches the Malay schedule on Phase 1, so a difference is unlikely.
